summary: Bonk, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Preferred Stock Redemption Agreement dated September 4, 2026 with Core4 Capital Holdings Corp, holder of 100,000 Series A Preferred Shares. Bonk will repurchase 26,667 Preferred Shares for $4,000,000 cash, wired within three business days, implying roughly $150 per preferred share. Core4 keeps 73,333 Preferred Shares, convertible in a merger to 1,516,873 common shares, and irrevocably waives anti-dilution, voting, liquidation preference, and conversion rights plus releases claims. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for overhang from remaining preferred and any common conversion risk.
